evidence: start: Detailed Description of Impact - some Persistent Disk volumes in the zone became unavailable from 18:24 Pacific, 23 Oct 2024. | end: Remediation and Mini Incident Report - all services in the zone fully restored by 02:09 Pacific, 24 Oct. | regions: Detailed impact - zone europe-west3-c failed, and instance and disk operations erred in every europe-west3 zone.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report post (31 Oct 2024 08:50 PDT). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). Coded regional because the report says other europe-west3 zones also saw errors (19:12 to 23:34) and several services were impacted region-wide. The arc flash occurred at 18:22 (header start 18:22), the Mini Incident Report gives the start as 18:30; 18:24 is the first stated customer impact. Header end is 02:01 while the reports give 02:09. Dataproc and Cloud SQL errors are stated to have continued until about 23:47 and 23:28 on 24 Oct for some customers; not used as the end. Mini Incident Report mentions europe-west5-c, apparently a typo; not coded. services_n counts Compute Engine, Persistent Disk, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Build, GKE, Vertex AI Batch Prediction and Cloud SQL.

evidence: start: Mini Incident Report - large model deployments began failing 14:08 Pacific on 22 Oct 2024. | end: Mini Incident Report - incident end given as 20:30 Pacific on 4 Nov 2024 after the configuration rollback. | regions: Affected locations list - 31 named regions; report says all regions except five were hit.
notes: Publication date is the Mini Incident Report post (5 Nov 2024 11:31 PST). Start converted from PDT (UTC-7); end converted from PST (UTC-8) since daylight saving ended 3 Nov 2024. The stated duration of 13 days 6 hours 22 minutes ignores the clock change; the UTC span is 13 days 7 hours 22 minutes. Resolution post says resolved as of 20:28. Regions are the 31 locations listed as affected; the report excludes asia-southeast1, europe-west4, us-central1, us-east1 and us-east4. Only Vertex AI Online Prediction (Model Garden deployments) is named as impaired; the header category Cloud Machine Learning is not counted.
